page-layout: full

```{=html}
<div class="page-header"><h1>Reading List</h1></div>
<p style="margin:0 0 1.5rem 0;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--text-muted);">An evolving collection of papers shaping how I think — across school attendance and emotionally based school avoidance, but also psychology, behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and education systems.</p>
<label for="reading-search" class="sr-only">Search reading list titles, authors, and notes</label>
<input id="reading-search" type="text" placeholder="Search titles, authors, notes…" style="width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0.5rem 0.85rem;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:inherit;border:1.5px solid var(--border,#ddd);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:0.85rem;outline:none;background:transparent;color:inherit;">
<div id="reading-filter-row" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;">
  <div id="reading-filter-bar" style="display:contents;"></div>
  <button id="reading-clear" style="display:none;background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--text-muted,#aaa);border-radius:999px;padding:0.25rem 0.85rem;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-muted,#888);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;opacity:0.8;">✕ Clear</button>
</div>
<div id="reading-list">
```

```{=html}
</div>
<script>
(function() {
  const filterBar = document.getElementById('reading-filter-bar');
  const searchEl  = document.getElementById('reading-search');
  const clearBtn  = document.getElementById('reading-clear');
  const noResults = document.getElementById('reading-no-results');

  const GROUPS = {
    'School attendance': {
      color: '#2d6a4f',
      tags: new Set(['EBSA','Chronic absenteeism','Re-engagement','Transition',
        'Systems model','Systems framework','Systems theory','Education system',
        'Education outcomes','Student voice','School staff','Developmental',
        'Definitions','Framework','Differentiation'])
    },
    'Interventions': {
      color: '#b04e3f',
      tags: new Set(['Intervention','CBT','DBT','Mindfulness','VR','Pharmacology',
        'Multifamily therapy','Family coaching','RCT','Feasibility','Treatment outcomes',
        'Rehabilitation','Intervention development','Intervention outcomes',
        'CBT play therapy','CBT programme','School-based CBT','Parent program'])
    },
    'Population & context': {
      color: '#7b4f9e',
      tags: new Set(['Autism','Neurodiversity','Parent','Anxiety','Mental health',
        'Psychopathology','Comorbidity','ACEs','Gender','Bullying',
        'Individual differences','Parent experience','Inclusion','Parent factors',
        'Personality','Behavioural addiction'])
    },
    'Study design': {
      color: '#2c6e8a',
      tags: new Set(['Systematic review','Scoping review','Meta-analysis','Qualitative',
        'RCT','Methods','Risk of bias','Measurement','Network analysis','Measurement tool',
        'Clinical review','Practitioner review','Review','Foundational',
        'Editorial','Clinical synthesis','Conceptual'])
    },
    'Digital & AI': {
      color: '#8a5c1a',
      tags: new Set(['Digital','AI','Machine learning','Creativity','Digital feasibility'])
    }
  };

  const allEntries = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.reading-entry'));

  const usedTags = new Set();
  allEntries.forEach(el => {
    try { JSON.parse(el.dataset.tags || '[]').forEach(t => usedTags.add(t)); } catch {}
  });

  function tagColor(tag) {
    for (const g of Object.values(GROUPS)) {
      if (g.tags.has(tag)) return g.color;
    }
    return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--navy').trim() || '#1e3a2a';
  }

  let activeFilters = new Set();
  let searchQuery   = '';
  let activeDropdownName = null;
  let activeDropdownEl   = null;

  var activeDropdownTrigger = null;

  function removeDropdown() {
    if (activeDropdownEl) { activeDropdownEl.remove(); activeDropdownEl = null; }
    activeDropdownName = null;
    activeDropdownTrigger = null;
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', () => { if (activeDropdownEl) { removeDropdown(); renderFilterBar(); } });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (!activeDropdownEl) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      var trigger = activeDropdownTrigger;
      removeDropdown(); renderFilterBar();
      if (trigger) trigger.focus();
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      var btns = Array.from(activeDropdownEl.querySelectorAll('button'));
      var idx = btns.indexOf(document.activeElement);
      var next = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? idx + 1 : idx - 1;
      if (next >= 0 && next < btns.length) btns[next].focus();
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  searchEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
    searchQuery = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    updateClearBtn();
    renderList();
  });

  clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    activeFilters.clear();
    searchQuery = '';
    searchEl.value = '';
    removeDropdown();
    updateClearBtn();
    renderFilterBar();
    renderList();
  });

  function updateClearBtn() {
    clearBtn.style.display = (activeFilters.size > 0 || searchQuery) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  }

  function groupState(name) {
    if (activeFilters.has(name)) return 'full';
    if ([...GROUPS[name].tags].some(t => activeFilters.has(t))) return 'partial';
    return 'off';
  }

  function entryMatchesEl(el) {
    if (searchQuery) {
      const hay = (el.dataset.search || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(searchQuery)) return false;
    }
    if (activeFilters.size === 0) return true;
    let tags = [];
    try { tags = JSON.parse(el.dataset.tags || '[]'); } catch {}
    for (const f of activeFilters) {
      if (GROUPS[f]) { if (tags.some(t => GROUPS[f].tags.has(t))) return true; }
      else            { if (tags.includes(f)) return true; }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function openDropdownFor(name, g, anchorEl, triggerBtn) {
    removeDropdown();
    activeDropdownName = name;
    activeDropdownTrigger = triggerBtn || null;
    const rect = anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dd   = document.createElement('div');
    dd.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');
    dd.setAttribute('aria-label', name + ' tag filters');
    dd.style.cssText = [
      'position:fixed',
      `top:${rect.bottom + 6}px`,
      `left:${rect.left}px`,
      'background:#ffffff',
      `border:1.5px solid ${g.color}`,
      'border-radius:10px',
      'padding:0.4rem 0.3rem',
      'z-index:99999',
      'min-width:180px',
      'box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.22)',
      'display:flex',
      'flex-direction:column',
      'gap:0.1rem',
    ].join(';');
    dd.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
    [...g.tags].filter(t => usedTags.has(t)).sort().forEach(tag => {
      const on = activeFilters.has(tag);
      const tb = document.createElement('button');
      tb.setAttribute('role', 'option');
      tb.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      tb.textContent = tag;
      tb.style.cssText = [
        `background:${on ? g.color : 'transparent'}`,
        `color:${on ? '#fff' : g.color}`,
        'border:none','text-align:left','padding:0.28rem 0.75rem',
        'border-radius:6px','cursor:pointer','font-size:0.78rem',
        `font-weight:${on ? 600 : 400}`,'font-family:inherit','transition:background 0.1s',
      ].join(';');
      tb.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { if (!on) tb.style.background = `color-mix(in srgb,${g.color} 10%,transparent)`; });
      tb.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { if (!on) tb.style.background = 'transparent'; });
      tb.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        activeFilters.delete(name);
        if (activeFilters.has(tag)) activeFilters.delete(tag); else activeFilters.add(tag);
        removeDropdown();
        updateClearBtn();
        renderFilterBar(); renderList();
      });
      dd.appendChild(tb);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(dd);
    activeDropdownEl = dd;
  }

  function renderFilterBar() {
    filterBar.innerHTML = '';
    Object.entries(GROUPS).forEach(([name, g]) => {
      const state     = groupState(name);
      const subActive = state !== 'full' ? [...g.tags].filter(t => activeFilters.has(t)) : [];
      const isOpen    = activeDropdownName === name;

      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:stretch;border:1.5px solid ' + g.color + ';border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;';

      const labelBtn = document.createElement('button');
      const labelOn  = state === 'full';
      labelBtn.textContent = subActive.length ? `${name} (${subActive.length})` : name;
      labelBtn.style.cssText = [
        `background:${labelOn ? g.color : 'transparent'}`,
        `color:${labelOn ? '#fff' : g.color}`,
        'padding:0.25rem 0.7rem 0.25rem 0.85rem','border:none','cursor:pointer',
        'font-size:0.78rem',`font-weight:${state !== 'off' ? 600 : 500}`,
        'font-family:inherit',`opacity:${state === 'off' ? 0.7 : 1}`,'transition:all 0.15s',
      ].join(';');
      labelBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        [...g.tags].forEach(t => activeFilters.delete(t));
        if (activeFilters.has(name)) activeFilters.delete(name); else activeFilters.add(name);
        removeDropdown();
        updateClearBtn();
        renderFilterBar(); renderList();
      });

      const chevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      chevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Show ${name} tag filters`);
      chevBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
      chevBtn.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
      chevBtn.innerHTML = '<span aria-hidden="true">&#9660;</span>';
      chevBtn.style.cssText = [
        `background:${isOpen || state !== 'off' ? `color-mix(in srgb,${g.color} 22%,transparent)` : 'transparent'}`,
        `color:${g.color}`,'padding:0.25rem 0.55rem','border:none',
        `border-left:1.5px solid ${g.color}50`,'cursor:pointer',
        'font-size:0.58rem','font-family:inherit','transition:all 0.15s',
      ].join(';');
      chevBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (isOpen) { removeDropdown(); renderFilterBar(); }
        else        { openDropdownFor(name, g, wrap, chevBtn); renderFilterBar(); }
      });

      wrap.appendChild(labelBtn);
      wrap.appendChild(chevBtn);
      filterBar.appendChild(wrap);
    });
  }

  function renderList() {
    let visibleCount = 0;
    allEntries.forEach(el => {
      const show = entryMatchesEl(el);
      el.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) visibleCount++;
    });
    if (noResults) noResults.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
  }

  renderFilterBar();
})();
</script>
```
